note: anvil L1 (chain 900) and anvil executors (chain 7001). Gas = L1 receipt gasUsed, summed per label; txs = count per label.

appSetup.what: AnchorRegistry, ChainlinkAdapter, ClearingCodec, ClearingVault, and the session code (ClearingDisputes + ClearingChannel): once per app

sessionSetup.what: vault.openSession: a 45-byte proxy of the session code plus its config, per session

idle: no L1 transactions while idle (no batch, no proposal). An Active session must still be watched: after takeoverDelay anyone may propose

monitoring.rule: Active (even idle): watch, proposals stay possible. Closing: watch until nothing is pending. Closed: nothing to watch once the close transaction is final on L1

recovery.bySize: contracts/test/clearing/ClearingSession.t.sol test_publishFinalCost: ~5k execution gas + 108 calldata bytes per user, linear; 1024 users in one chunk = 5.1M execution gas + 110 KB

restart.what: open session 2 (one transaction), start an empty executor; no replay of session 1
